description: The GCP projects Plutus discovered behind the connection: how many are readable, unreadable or excluded, and per project the access status, the fix when it is unreadable, and whether it is included. `enabled` false means multi-project coverage is off for this account. Change inclusion with set_gcp_project_included. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/gcp/projects.
name: list_gcp_projects
